title: DAILY PROVISION
MATTHEW 6:11
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: golden morning light river stone table
sunlight through trees peaceful forest path

scenes.a: As you calculate tonight's exact shortfall and wonder how the table will remain full, listen closely to His voice.
Father, we come before You acknowledging that every good gift and every necessary provision comes from Your open hand.
We lay down the frantic striving of tomorrow and quiet our anxious thoughts right here in Your holy presence.
Your holy word guides our lips and anchors our faith as we pray together:
Give us this day our daily bread.
Sustain us through every trial, fill our hands with what we need, and strengthen our trust in Your unfailing faithfulness.
